capture_mode: deterministic hidden in-app replay through canvas_input
cursor_cue: The curved-guide strokes are prepared by scripted production handlers before capture; playback shows a synthetic ORBIT cursor and a persistent no-pressure disclosure.

input_note: Synthetic PenSample input uses pressure=None and no tilt. The app applies its fixed default mouse-like width; no tablet pressure or latency was measured.
license_or_provenance: Procedurally generated from an empty Sketch3D document by the production pointer-action handlers; no external artwork or assets.

poster.alt: A saved cylinder with editable curved and mirrored strokes in Sketch3D's dark workspace.

review.notes: Synthetic curved-guide draft. The strokes are scripted through production handlers before the captured orbit; review playback and visual readability before use.

shot_steps: Create a saved cylinder and mirrored curved strokes through the production pointer-action handlers.
Orbit the camera using a synthetic barrel gesture through canvas_input.
Pause on the editable cylinder and reflected strokes.
